id.title: Id
id.description: The request's own id, a UUID.

received.title: Received
received.description: When the hub received it, ISO 8601.

ref.title: Reference
ref.description: Where it came from: a file name or an issue address.

from.title: From
from.description: The asking instance: name, type and public https address. No person.

answers.title: Answers
answers.description: The answers to the hub's asks, by ask.

invite.title: Invite
invite.description: The id of the invite that matched. Never the token.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: What the hub did with it.

proposal.title: Proposal
proposal.description: The proposal opened for it, when outcome is proposed.
